formats.key: TransferWithAuthorization(address from,address to,uint256 value,uint256 validAfter,uint256 validBefore,bytes32 nonce)
effects: Once anyone submits the signed authorization, `value` USD₮0 moves from `from` (the signer) to `to` through `_transfer(from, to, value)` in TetherTokenV2.transferWithAuthorization. No fee and no other deduction applies.
The authorization only works when validAfter < block.timestamp < validBefore (EIP3009._requireValidAuthorization).
The signer's `nonce` is marked as used, so the same authorization cannot run twice (EIP3009._markAuthorizationAsUsed).
formats.shown: The screen says 'Authorize USDT0 transfer' and shows From, To, the amount as USDT0 (token taken from the verifying contract), and the Valid after and Valid before dates. The nonce is hidden.

findings.title: TransferWithAuthorization has no interpolatedIntent, so the intent line leaves out the amount and the recipient.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json, TransferWithAuthorization format: intent is 'Authorize USDT0 transfer' and there is no interpolatedIntent (FORMATS.md: interpolatedIntent: null). In case 0 the amount (100 USDT0) and the recipient (0x1111...) appear only as separate fields.

findings.title: TransferWithAuthorization: anyone holding the signature can submit it, but the screen does not say so.
findings.evidence: TetherTokenV2.sol transferWithAuthorization is 'public onlyNotBlocked' and has no msg.sender == to check. Only _receiveWithAuthorizationValidityCheck in EIP3009.sol (line 130) has that check. The funds still go only to the 'to' shown, so the signer's outcome is unchanged.
findings.fix: Optionally say in the intent that this is a signed authorization any relayer can execute.
